title: Video-to-Music Generation for Gameplay Videos
abstract: arXiv:2609.31810v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Video-to-music models have advanced considerably in the last few years, particularly in film and music video applications. In this paper, we investigate this problem in the video game domain, which introduces new challenges for these models: video frames are rendered graphics, music is mostly synthetic audio, and soundtracks loop across entire levels rather than following on-screen events. We introduce a new dataset of 217.6 hours of Super Nintendo (SNES) gameplay video paired with 485 hours of clean soundtracks, free of sound effects and voice-overs, matched to gameplay audio via audio fingerprinting. With this dataset, we train a simple encoder-decoder transformer that passes video features directly to a MusicGen decoder, comparing different encoding strategies: textual descriptions (T5), independent frames (ViT), or spatiotemporal patches (ViViT). translated_title: 面向游戏视频的视觉生成音乐
translated_abstract: 近年来，视频到音乐模型取得了长足进展，尤其是在电影和音乐视频应用领域。本文在电子游戏领域研究这一问题，这为此类模型带来了新的挑战：视频帧是渲染的图形，音乐大多是合成音频，且配乐在整个游戏关卡中循环播放，而不是跟随屏幕上的事件变化。我们引入了一个新数据集，包含217.6小时的超级任天堂（SNES）游戏视频，并配有485小时无音效和配音干扰的干净配乐，这些配乐通过音频指纹技术与游戏音频相匹配。基于该数据集，我们训练了一个简单的编码器-解码器Transformer，将视频特征直接传递给MusicGen解码器，并比较了不同的编码策略：文本描述（T5）、独立帧（ViT）或时空补丁（ViViT）。每种编码器均在冻结和微调两种设置下进行测试，而解码器则始终……
tldr: 本文首次研究了游戏视频领域的视频生成音乐问题，构建了包含217.6小时SNES游戏视频与485小时干净配乐的新数据集，并训练将视频特征直接传入MusicGen解码器的Transformer模型，系统比较了T5、ViT和ViViT等多种视频编码策略。
en_tdlr: This paper pioneers video-to-music generation for gameplay videos by introducing a new dataset of 217.6 hours of SNES gameplay paired with 485 hours of clean soundtracks, and training an encoder-decoder transformer that feeds video features (T5, ViT, or ViViT encodings) directly into a MusicGen decoder.
